The page asked for, else the one the teacher has open, else where the lesson starts; its words, and the words
marked on it. For the lesson's teacher, its student and the student's guardians, in a lesson of a course the
hifz map follows (a Quran subject's).

role.description: teacher (turns the pages and marks words), student or guardian (follow and read)

can_mark.description: Whether I may mark words now (the teacher, from the room's opening until the report is handed in).

teacher_page.description: The page the teacher has open: the student's screen follows it; null until the teacher turns one.

start_page.description: Where the lesson starts (its plan's passage of the Quran, else the oldest page due for review).

basmala.description: The basmala's words from the platform's copy, shown at the head of a surah that begins on this page (not al-Fatiha, not at-Tawba); null when none begins here.

verses.description: The page's verses, each word as written; a word is its surah, its verse and its place in the verse from 1.

words.description: Each word as written, from the first.

marks.description: Words marked in this lesson: kind wrong, hesitation or tajweed.

earlier.description: Words on this page marked in the student's earlier lessons (shown faintly): the latest kind and how many times.

attribution.description: The attribution the text is shown with.

put.description: The teacher only; the student's screen follows (live).

get.description:
Every page of the mushaf by part (new, learning, or memorized and strong, fading or weak now), how many of
each, and today's review on the learner's clock. mode: check (recite a page; it is heard and checked) or self
(say how it went). The latest page recited in the last day comes with its check.

get.description:
The plan the lesson follows (its course's, or its group's) with today's portion: the new part, the near and
far reviews (passages by surah and verses, and their pages), the exam stops it reaches, and whether the plan
is frozen (the course paused or over). plan is null for a course with no Quran plan: it has no portion. With
the academy's mistake types and grades, and what was already recorded for each student.

parameters.description: The academy's slug, until a token names it (a token for another academy is refused).

track.description: hifz, tilawa, talqin, noorani, review or ijaza

unit.description: verses, lines, page, quarter_hizb or lesson (the Noorani Qaida)

pace.description: The learner's own pace (the program's where the plan sets none).

position.description: Where the next new portion starts; null once the program is complete.

frozen.description: paused or ended: the plan waits where it is; null when it moves on

progress.description: How much of the program's scope is behind the learner, 0 to 1.

lesson.description: On the Noorani Qaida: the lesson's number and title.

stops.description: The exam stops the new part completes (end of a surah or a part).

advanced.description: Whether the position moved past the new part.

frozen.description: The course was paused or over: nothing moved.

post.description:
For each student (students[].student_id; a one-to-one lesson may leave it out), each part of today's portion
they recited (parts.new, parts.near, parts.far) with its mistakes by kind (mistakes: [{kind, count}], else the
words marked in the lesson's mushaf), and the teacher's own grade with a note when it differs from the mistakes'. The
position moves past the new part only when it reaches the program's pass grade (a group's: most of its
students), and never while the course is paused or over. Once per lesson and student.

get.description:
The exams booked with the person signed in as examiner (soonest first), with the academy's mistake types and
grades, and the last results they recorded.

post.description:
The examiner alone, from the assessment lesson's opening on, once: the mistakes by kind (mistakes: [{kind,
count}], else the words marked in the lesson's mushaf) and their own grade with a note when it differs. Passed
at the program's pass grade; a fail needs note (what to work on) and retake_on (a day after today, at most 180
days ahead), and the retake is suggested for that day. A pass earns a certificate when the academy gives them.
